about_the_game:
Intense shoot-em-up action with a roguelite twist from the creators of the critically-acclaimed Hyper Sentinel. It's Uridium and Paradroid meets Hades in an explosive fusion of gameplay styles:

DESTROY THE DEFENCES

Swoop across the surface of colossal, procedurally-generated space-destroyers and enemy bases in your Sentinel fighter. Harness the silky smooth controls to dog-fight, dodge and destroy surface defences. Endlessly replayable sandbox shoot-em-up action!

  • Blistering combat built on fast, fluid controls

  • Pick your targets wisely to affect the challenges that await within

  • Defeat monstruous bosses and discover awesome ship upgrades

PLUNDER THE DEPTHS

Once the defences have been lowered, land your ship and send your Hyper Droid inside to plunder and pillage whatever you can steal before the whole place self destructs. Make choices on the fly to ensure you maximise your plunder, but make sure you get out before the whole place goes boom.

  • Steal your enemies form and weapons to turn their abilities against them

  • Hunt down the Mother-Brain to secure powerful upgrade pods

  • Grab what you can and escape before the time runs out

UPGRADE & EXPLORE

When you fall in battle, time rewinds, sending you back to Moonbase Alpha—your hub for reinvention. Spend your hard-earned currency on game-changing meta upgrades that permanently enhance your abilities. Between runs, interact with a colorful cast of characters, each adding layers to the unfolding space soap opera, where the story evolves based on your in-game achievements. Upgrade the once-barren moonbase into a thriving sanctuary, unlocking powerful buffs as you transform it into a true home among the stars.

ARCADE RE-IMAGINED BEYOND YOUR MEMORIES

Hyper Sentinel Fusion stays true to its arcade roots while embracing the roguelite format, delivering a fresh yet familiar experience for a new generation. This is the game you dreamed of as a kid—now brought to life with modern visuals, refined gameplay, and all the polish you’d expect from today’s best.

  • A fusion of two of the greatest C64 games ever made, reimagined for a new audience

  • Modern graphical techniques bring pixel art to life like never before

  • A deep, rewarding gameplay loop keeps the action endlessly replayable

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 8.1
  • Processor: 1.8GHz Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Built In

short_description: An intense shoot-em-up + roguelite fusion. Pilot your fighter to destroy the defences of procedurally-generated space titans, then land, infiltrate and plunder the depths with your droid. Spend your bounty on epic upgrades & explore the moon base hub to interact with characters & unlock secrets.
